Thanks Alex — great next steps. I've drafted a MAP (attached) with milestones, owners, target dates, and dependencies. High level summary below:

MAP milestone: POC environment setup (owner: Redwood infra / Marissa)
- Target: POC start by 2026-07-30 (dependent on SSO/KMS & VPC peering)
- Responsibilities:
  - Redwood: provide peering config, public IPs for allowlist, SAML SP metadata, deployment manifest
  - Acme: approve peering, add allowlist entries, provide IdP metadata and KMS access plan
- Dependencies: VPC peering acceptance window (Acme network), IP allowlist applied, SSO/SAML exchange, Secrets/KMS policy and key access

Open items / asks for Acme team:
1) Confirm contact for AWS/VPC peering (network engineer) and available maintenance window.
2) Provide IdP metadata (SAML) and any SCIM requirements.
3) Confirm KMS approach: will you grant a cross-account key role or provide a wrapped secret?

Attached: Redwood-MAP-draft-v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

I'll coordinate with Nikhil & Dev on the technical TODOs and propose time slots for a short technical call to lock network details.

Best,

Hi Marissa — putting our network notes here:
- We can accept VPC peering, need proposed peering CIDR and account IDs. Maintenance window: preferred 2026-07-24 00:00-04:00 UTC.
- IP allowlist: send the list of egress + control plane IPs (we will add to firewall).
- SAML: we need SP metadata and attribute mapping. We will share our IdP metadata (attached in separate email).
- KMS: Acme prefers to manage keys; we can create a cross-account role for Redwood to use with least privilege. We'll need the exact IAM role ARN and the list of API actions you require.

Quick Q: do you require a dedicated subnet or can we provide a shared peering endpoint?

Regards,

Thanks — marking the network window. Some technical notes from our infra team to make the peering and access smoother: 
- Peering: we'll provide the Redwood account ID and the peering CIDR (10.40.0.0/16) by EOD Monday 2026-07-06. We can support either dedicated subnet or shared endpoint; dedicated subnet recommended for predictable routing.
- IP allowlist: control plane/outbound IPs: 34.210.12.45, 34.210.12.46; management plane: 52.33.110.10 (please add both egress and ingress where applicable).
- SSO/SAML: we need the Acme IdP metadata and attribute mapping for email and groups. Also confirm whether SCIM is required for provisioning (optional).
- KMS/Secrets: cross-account role is preferred. We'll send a minimal IAM policy and role ARN we need. If you prefer wrapped secrets, please share the process and folder for retrieving them.

I've added a short checklist in our Confluence page to capture each milestone and owner: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-1234

Proposed next steps:
- Technical sync: Tues 2026-07-07 11:00 AM PT (30m) — confirm?
- Acme to share IdP metadata and confirm peering window by 2026-07-06
